name: Mysteriously Sanctioned
body:
Your divine revelations are stronger than ever.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 17, Godstouched, Godstouched Focus, Mysteriously Chosen, Mysteriously Elected, character level 15th.

Benefit: You gain an additional revelation from the mystery you selected with the Mysteriously Chosen feat.

This revelation must be available to an 11th-level oracle. For purposes of using that revelation, treat your character level as your oracle level for all your revelations granted by this feat, Mysteriously Chosen, and Mysteriously Elected.
